basic_info.description: 761-765 Pine Street is a four (4) unit building located between Powell and Mason Streets in downtown SF. All four units will be delivered vacant. Three of the units are full-floor flats measuring approximately 1,100-1,300 sq/ft each. The fourth unit (8 Fella  Place) is a 2-bedroom unit that enters from the rear of the property from Fella Place.  The Pine Street units have spacious layouts that could be used as three or four bedroom  units. The units are in various stages of completion and will likely require  updating in order to be rent-ready. Assuming full occupancy, the property should  collect rent of $14,500/mo+. This income equates to 6.1% cap and 11.47 GRM  (assuming appropriate updating to achieve market rents).  761-765 Pine Street is a fantastic, blank slate'' opportunity for an investor or  developer to add-value, blocks from Union Square and the Financial District.
